messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD — 'Warranty & indemnity insurance in mid-market M&A'
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

A reminder that this month's CPD session, 'Warranty & indemnity insurance in mid-market M&A', takes place on Thursday 23 October at 12.30pm in the Bishopsgate training room. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to me by Tuesday for catering numbers.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
